title: Публикация только владельцем
rule: decision(role, approved) returns a bool. Publication is permitted if and only if role is exactly 'owner' AND approved is True. All other roles must be denied. The input universe is exactly the listed finite domains.
original:
def decision(role, approved):
    return role == "owner" and approved
seed:
def decision(role, approved):
    return role in {"owner", "editor"} and approved
target: Allow editor when approved=True as well as owner; preserve the original output on EVERY other input in the domain.
